name: stt-eval-seed
description: Evaluation set v2 for the transcription capability, sliced by declared language (M5 step 4). v1's four clips are carried forward byte-identical - same pins, same hashes, same references - so an `en` run on v2 is comparable to the v1 baseline. What v2 adds is the LANGUAGE DECLARATION as an experimental variable: the same deterministic probe audio is declared as `en` and as `hi`, so the incumbent's hallucination behaviour under a Hindi declaration becomes measurable without any third-party corpus. IMPORTANT AND DELIBERATE: the `hi` slice contains NO natural speech. It can measure hallucination and it cannot measure word error rate, so it is not a quality claim about Hindi and cannot support promotion to `supported`. A Hindi natural-speech corpus is a commissioning decision (F-M5-8), the sibling of the Arabic corpus (F-M5-6). Immutable once released: changes create v3.

clips.notes: Same speech via the WAV decode path — container handling must not change the transcript.
Hallucination probe: every emitted word is a failure. Targets Whisper's documented silence failure mode; gates the VAD pipeline stage.
Non-speech audio probe (pure tone): correct output is an empty transcript.
Control for hi-silence-10s: identical audio, English declared. The pair isolates the effect of the DECLARATION on hallucination.
Control for hi-tone-440hz-5s: identical audio, English declared.
Hindi-declared silence. Correct output is an empty transcript; every emitted word is a hallucination the customer would be charged for.
Hindi-declared non-speech audio. Correct output is an empty transcript.
